edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed by the parties in writing (the “Settlement Amount”) by electronic transfer within ten business days after this Agreement is signed by both parties. Plaintiff shall provide reasonable payment instructions.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the matters described in the pleadings in this action through the date this Agreement is signed. This release does not affect either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers; as required by law, court order, or regulatory process; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a permitted disclosure shall, where practicable, inform the recipient of the confidential nature of the terms.
